Seti Astro Suite Pro

V2.0.0
A fresh start for new and returning users: a Welcome and Setup window that installs acceleration, AI models and Gaia catalogs for you, a Start Panel, a two-row Essentials toolbar (All Tools is one click away, and your 1.x layout comes back from the welcome window or View > Layout), and linear images that open display-stretched. New Quick Stack stacks lights, darks and flats with one button on an NVIDIA GPU or the CPU, with nothing written to disk. Also new: Banding Blaster, an Eraser in Clone Stamp and Blemish Blaster, per-group Dark and Flat picks in the Stacking Suite, a plate-solution check before SPCC, SSSC and NBExtract, star statistics in Image Peeker, faster Cosmic Clarity on NVIDIA, a fix for black Cosmic Clarity and Dark Star results on AMD RX 9000 cards, and about 16,000 translated strings per language. Full release notes: https://github.com/setiastro/setiastrosuitepro/releases
